inputs: Frozen v1.2 results plus frozen relation overlay; existing fixed10000 mapping; no new extraction
research_scope: Employer wording about experience, qualifications, technology and responsibility; current fixed sample, not historical causal identification
accepted_claim_level: Reproducible observed-text statistics at their explicit operational definitions. Do not relabel these as semantically validated latent requirements, entry-job shares, employer preferences, actual adoption or effects.
estimator: Unweighted finite-sample description; legacy arms are not treatment-control; no inference to US or all LinkUp

T1.title: Current-sample coverage and processing funnel
required: at least one numeric duration evidence
T1.whole_corpus: Only cite independently sourced prior inventories with provenance; absent population inputs means not estimable

T2.title: Four experience-text dimensions, stated numeric durations and unresolved evidence
T2.broad: Any object membership in frozen experience evidence; overlapping candidate counts
T2.narrow: Exactly one object AND explicit_rule_candidate AND unconditional_explicit_clause; not a semantic accuracy certificate
T2.years: Numeric literal duration candidates; distinguish min/range/max/exact/unspecified and missing; no collapse of alternative or multiple clauses to one posting minimum
T2.required_vs_preferred: Report recorded clause strength with scope caveat; heading inference not a validated requirement label
T2.denominator: Document incidence plus separate evidence counts; overlapping rows explicitly nonadditive

T3.title: Technology mentions, proximity-role cues, explicit-use phrases and overlap
T3.technology: Frozen non-negated lexicon matches, incl unspecifiedAI separately; not adoption
T3.role: Existing neighboring-verb cue counts and explicit_using_named_tool overlay separately; do not force a single document role
T3.cooccurrence: Technology text match crossed with experience object text match; no causal interpretation
T3.overlap: Mutually exclusive combinations of tech lexicon families; no-match labelled not_observed_by_rules

T4.title: Created-year snapshot cohorts and timing limitations
T4.cohort_unit: represented_posting only, one observed created_year per row
T4.extra: If available, unique exact texts connected to multiple created_year values; means shared text across metadata cohorts, NOT historic versions or updates
T4.unavailable: Explicit not_available/not_verified rows, never zero; no historical trend claim

T5.title: Two core within-document wording comparisons
T5.comparison1: General-work and related (occupation_task OR industry_domain OR tool) as TWO independent match indicators, four states both/general_only/related_only/neither_observed; never prioritize general and discard both. Compute broad and narrow separately.
T5.comparison2: Experience-object indicators and responsibility cues crossed with (i) broad entry/junior/graduate/waiver text cues and (ii) explicit no-experience waiver or graduate wording only. Drop junior-alone from narrow eligibility proxy; scope remains candidate and no cooccurrence implies same requirement.
T5.responsibility: Existing people_supervision, independent_responsibility, client_ownership or mentoring_other_people markers; exclude client_contact_only and execution_assistance from this combined measure
T5.unknown: Neither/no cue is not observed, not confirmed absence
T5.no_regression: No effect estimates, no seniorization trend, no invented matched-firm panel

T6.title: Three sensitivity groups and claim availability
groups: all evidence versus exclusion of needs_review/conditional/background-heading-flagged evidence
T6.required: Report numerator, full denominator, fraction, retained evidence and not_observed; broad/narrow comparisons same target dimension; include per-table allowed and forbidden claims

review.purpose: Bounded Pro diagnostic acceptance of named observables; not independent gold validation or statistical accuracy estimate

completion: Six table groups, public scheduled receipt, independent numerical QA, one concise findings/limitations report, versioned code and Git. No additional semantic-development iteration this release.
